title: Merit Scholarships
aliases: how can I get a scholarship
content: VIT-AP offers merit scholarships including the GV Merit Scholarship (100% scholarship for any board topper in the country, for UG B.Com/B.A. programmes) and the Tmt. Rajeswari Ammal Merit Scholarship (50% for any district topper, with an additional 25% for a girl topper, making it 75%). For PG non-engineering programmes, the G.V. PG Merit Scholarship offers 100% for candidates with a CGPA of 9.0 or 90%+ in their qualifying UG degree, and the Rajeswari PG Merit Scholarship offers 50% (75% for girl candidates) for 8.0 CGPA/80%+; these PG scholarships apply to M.Sc Physics and M.Sc Chemistry admissions.

title: Programme Fee Structure
content: VIT-AP publishes detailed, programme-specific fee structures (B.Tech, Integrated M.Tech, MBA, M.Sc, BBA, law, and other programmes) on its official Fees & Scholarships page. Because exact fee amounts vary by programme and are updated for each admission cycle, check the current figures directly at the source link below rather than relying on a fixed number here.
